# Resuming a file an agent was still writing

The planner, the verifier and the debugger write their file in parts. The
planner and the verifier write the frontmatter first and put the line
`<!-- accord: unfinished -->` right after the frontmatter, then add each part as
it is finished.
The debugger puts the line as the first line under the last `## Episode <n>`
heading of `debug.md`, before the rest of its episode. Each removes the line as
its last step. A `plan.md` or `verification.md` that carries the line on any
line outside a code fence, and a `debug.md` that carries it first under its
open episode's heading, was left by an agent that stalled, so it is not
finished. `accord gate plan` and `accord gate done` refuse such a file, and
`accord anchor` prints an `Unfinished:` line for it. Never commit it as
finished, and never finish the agent's parts yourself.

**Plan.** A `plan.md` the anchor shows at `Stage: plan` is not committed as
ready. When `accord anchor` prints
`Unfinished: accord/tickets/<id>/plan.md: resume the planner`, dispatch
`accord-planner` with the inputs of step 2 plus the path of `plan.md` and the
words `resume mode`. It keeps every finished task and writes the rest. Then go
on at step 4.

**Verify.** When the line ends `: resume the verifier`, dispatch
`accord-verifier` with the path of `accord/tickets/<id>.md`, the path of
`accord/tickets/<id>/verification.md` and the words `resume mode`; it keeps
every finished block. When it ends `: start the verifier over`, the work moved
since the blocks were written, so remove `verification.md` and dispatch the
verifier as step 3 does, with no `resume mode`.

**Debug.** In `debug.md` the line is the first line under the last
`## Episode <n>` heading, with earlier episodes above it. An episode is open
while no `## Resolved` heading follows its `## Episode <n>` heading; a later
heading after `## Resolved` does not reopen it, and a new `## Episode` starts a
new one. When the line ends `: resume the debugger`, dispatch `accord-debugger`
with the path of the ticket file, the failing command and its output, the path
of `debug.md` and the words `resume mode`; it keeps every finished part and
goes on from the last one. A debugger dispatched on one hypothesis in a
parallel round writes nothing, so it never leaves the line.
